scientific_integrity.basis: Full analytic proof using exact monomial moments, harmonic partial fractions, and uniform asymptotics; finite checks supplementary.
scientific_integrity.limitations: Only the Hilbert–Schmidt classification and its exact trace/residue are proved; broader Schatten classes and singular-value asymptotics are not claimed. Priority requires independent scrutiny.

title: A sharp Hilbert–Schmidt transition and unit spectral-energy residue at the logarithmic Bergman threshold
